acceptance_criteria: JBD engine and waveguide controlled datasheet matches the candidate interface; sample measured within agreed tolerances
required_evidence: Current vendor datasheet; sample serial numbers; incoming inspection report
blocker_or_dependency: No supplier quote or controlled dimension drawing in the research export

acceptance_criteria: Left and right virtual images overlap within 3 arcmin relative; specified eye-box and transparency verified on a bench
required_evidence: Optical bench MTF; luminance; contrast; ghost; eye-box; transparency measurements

acceptance_criteria: Per-eye alignment budget supports the 3 arcmin system requirement including thermal drift
required_evidence: Alignment sensitivity model; adhesive cure data; thermal drift test
blocker_or_dependency: Original 0.1 degree claim was incorrect and no replacement budget exists

acceptance_criteria: Selected bridge stores or streams required image data without dropped frames at the approved resolution and refresh
required_evidence: Memory map; worst-case bandwidth calculation; timing simulation; bench capture
blocker_or_dependency: 1.14 Mbit memory cannot hold one 1.2288 Mbit frame; single 40 MHz QSPI margin is insufficient for unproven dual 60 Hz full-frame refresh

acceptance_criteria: All bridge-to-engine signals meet vendor timing and voltage limits with production tolerances
required_evidence: Oscilloscope captures at corners; level-shifter selection; SI simulation
blocker_or_dependency: Vendor input protocol and IO voltage are not confirmed

acceptance_criteria: Calibrated scale measurement is at or below 40.0 g using the defined boundary
required_evidence: CAD mass properties; tolerance stack; 10-unit scale data
blocker_or_dependency: 39.5 g is only an allocation; every component mass is UNVERIFIED

acceptance_criteria: Survives defined drop; torsion; hinge cycle; nose-load and wearer comfort targets
required_evidence: CAD; FEA; drop test; hinge life test; human factors study
blocker_or_dependency: No released CAD or mechanical prototype

acceptance_criteria: Each cell has independent protection and CC/CV termination; no cross-charge or uncontrolled parallel current
required_evidence: Charger schematic; fault tree; HIL test; thermal test at cell level
blocker_or_dependency: Single BQ24072 plus LM66200 topology is not a valid dual-cell charger

acceptance_criteria: System remains above minimum operating voltage during Wi-Fi plus camera plus display peaks across the battery range
required_evidence: Load profile; PDN impedance; buck-boost transient measurement
blocker_or_dependency: Peak current budget and the actual audio/display parts are not final

acceptance_criteria: Skin-contact surfaces stay within the applicable standard and product comfort limit for the defined use profile
required_evidence: IR thermography; thermocouples; IEC 62368-1 clause review and applicable limits
blocker_or_dependency: No thermal model; 43 C was overgeneralized as a universal limit

acceptance_criteria: Open; short; bypass and stuck-on LED faults remove or prevent camera capture within the specified response
required_evidence: Fault injection; current-window measurement; independent safety review
blocker_or_dependency: Interlock is a concept only; no prototype or firmware test

acceptance_criteria: HFP call; A2DP playback; AI TTS and microphone path work with the selected phone and audio SoC
required_evidence: Audio SoC datasheet; I2S/UART test; phone interoperability matrix
blocker_or_dependency: No audio SoC selected and ESP32-S3 alone lacks classic Bluetooth

acceptance_criteria: Approved HUD payload transfers from app to display with bounded latency and error recovery
required_evidence: GATT definition; firmware implementation; Flutter adapter; end-to-end latency log
blocker_or_dependency: HUD characteristic and optical adapter are not implemented

acceptance_criteria: Wi-Fi; BLE and classic Bluetooth meet isolation; desense and SAR/EMC requirements
required_evidence: Antenna simulation; chamber measurement; SAR and EMC pre-scan
blocker_or_dependency: No RF layout; no coexistence plan validated

acceptance_criteria: USB 2.0 passes eye and BER targets with the released stackup and native DRC clean
required_evidence: Controlled stackup; impedance coupon; native ERC/DRC; eye diagram
blocker_or_dependency: Native KiCad checks were NOT RUN and USB routing was incomplete in the source baseline

acceptance_criteria: Applicable IEC 62368-1; EMC; RF; battery transport and optical eye-safety requirements are identified and scheduled
required_evidence: Regulatory matrix; accredited-lab quote; laser/optical safety assessment
blocker_or_dependency: No regulatory plan; not a certified device

acceptance_criteria: Quoted BOM and NRE fit the approved target with lead-time and MOQ risks documented
required_evidence: RFQs; samples; NRE quotes; second-source plan
blocker_or_dependency: All cost ranges in the research export are UNVERIFIED

acceptance_criteria: Assembly; test points; antenna tune; calibration and end-of-line test are defined for a pilot build
required_evidence: DFM review; fixture plan; test coverage; yield assumptions
blocker_or_dependency: No released PCB; no factory DFM review; NOT FOR FAB
